cards.text: Back in Jerusalem, Jesus healed a man who had been an invalid for thirty-eight years (John 5:5-9). After this, Jesus crosses to the other side of the Sea of Galilee, also called the Sea of Tiberias. And a large crowd is following Him.

cards.question: A large crowd follows Jesus across the Sea of Galilee. Why are they following Him?

answers.text: They saw His signs on the sick
He invited them to the mountain

cards.text: Jesus goes up on the mountain and sits down with His disciples, and the Jewish Feast of the Passover is near. When He looks up and sees a large crowd coming toward Him, He asks Philip, one of His disciples, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”

cards.question: Jesus asks Philip where to buy bread for the crowd. He's asking to ___ Philip, because He already knows what He's about to do.

cards.text: So Philip looks out at that large crowd and does the math out loud. Friend, I can't even split one batch of cookies evenly without three tries and a recount.

cards.question: Philip figures two hundred denarii would buy enough bread for everyone in the crowd to have a small piece.

cards.text: Then Andrew, another disciple and Simon Peter's brother, speaks up. He points out a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish.

cards.question: Andrew asks what difference the boy's five loaves and two fish will make among so many people.

cards.text: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus says. There's plenty of grass in that place, so the men sit down, about five thousand of them.

cards.question: Jesus takes the loaves and the fish, gives thanks, and hands them out to everyone seated. How much does each person get?

cards.text: Everyone is full, and then Jesus gives His disciples a cleanup job. Friend, the second anybody says the word “cleanup,” I am suddenly VERY busy checking an oven timer.

cards.question: Once everyone is full, Jesus tells His disciples to gather the leftover pieces so that nothing will be ___.

cards.text: The disciples fill twelve baskets with the leftover pieces of those five barley loaves. I've baked a LOT of batches, friend, and I have NEVER ended one with more than I started with.

cards.question: When the people see the sign Jesus performed with the loaves, what do they start saying about Him?

answers.text: This is the Prophet who is to come
This is Elijah come back to them
This is a new teacher of the law

cards.text: Then Jesus realizes what this crowd is about to do. They're about to come and make Him king, by force.

cards.question: Jesus realizes the crowd is about to make Him king by force. What does He do?

answers.text: Withdraws to a mountain by Himself
Sends the crowd away to the villages
Lets them take Him to Jerusalem

cards.text: When evening comes, His disciples go down to the sea. They get into a boat and start across the sea to Capernaum.

cards.question: When the disciples set out across the sea, Jesus is in the boat with them.

cards.text: It's already dark, a strong wind is blowing, and the sea grows agitated. I spent years in the dark in a junk drawer, friend, and at least nobody asked me to row.
They've rowed about three or four miles when they see Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the sea.

cards.question: When the disciples see Jesus walking on the sea toward their boat, they're terrified.
The disciples are terrified as Jesus comes toward their boat on the sea. What does He tell them?

answers.text: It's Him and not to be afraid
To row harder for the shore
To keep quiet and hold on tight

cards.question: Jesus tells His terrified disciples, “It is I; do not be afraid.” What happens next?

answers.text: They take Him in and land at once
They row the rest of the night to land
They turn the boat back toward the crowd

cards.text: The boat reaches the shore, but keep that apron on, friend. This story is just getting started.
